items.name: MT AI 插件
items.description: AI-powered enhancement plugin for MT Manager, built for developers. AI code intelligence: full-document analysis, selection diagnosis, optimization suggestions, writing & polishing, code patching, code minification, encryption & decryption, compatible with OpenAI-style APIs (DeepSeek/OpenAI/Groq...). Multi-engine translation: 12 standalone engines — 8 free & keyless (Google CN, Bing, Yandex, Baidu Web, Youdao, MyMemory, LibreTranslate, Lingva) plus 4 paid options (Tencent Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, DeepL, Baidu Translate API). Developer utilities: Base64/Base32/Hex/URL codec, MD5/SHA hashing, Unix timestamp & date conversion, AES/DES encryption; code formatting (JSON/XML/SQL pretty & minify); regex tester. Multi-format previewer: native rich-text (Html.fromHtml) rendering inside MT for Markdown, JSON, XML, SQL, HTML, ELF/SO libraries, hex, Base64 images — no browser kernel, never crashes. Text tools: character stats, UUID generation, case & naming-style (snake/camel) conversion, base converter (2/8/10/16), line ops (dedup/sort/strip-blank/duplicate-count), random password generator, color converter (HEX↔RGB). More tools: text diff, URL parsing & param extraction, mojibake fix / encoding conversion, batch find-replace (regex supported), fake data generator (name/phone/email/ID/address). The "About" button at the bottom-left of the main panel shows the author team and homepage links. Settings page links your homepage (nekoaidev.top) and GitHub (github.com/xiaohondan) — one tap opens them in MT's built-in browser. Entry: the "MT AI" item in the editor's bottom function bar or top "Edit" group.

items.name: Rime 码表助手
items.description:
Rime 词库工具
1. 智能编码生成机制
本 Rime 词库工具采用先进的翻译模式，针对无编码词条，能够自动化精准生成对应编码，进而输出完备的带编码词条，有效提升词库构建的准确性与便捷性。
2. 精准文本限制策略
出于系统稳定性考量，工具仅处理虎单字前 16000 字范围的文本内容。这一设定巧妙规避因数据量过载而衍生的潜在风险，保障词库生成流程平稳、高效。
3. 高效批量处理能力
为大幅提高操作效率，工具全面支持批量多行文本处理。用户一次性导入多行文本，即可同步开展编码生成作业，无需逐个词条依次处理，极大节省时间成本。
4. 本地化独立运行环境
整个词库生成流程完全基于本地运行，彻底摆脱网络依赖。此特性不仅保证操作不受网络波动干扰，更从根源上筑牢数据安全防线，全方位守护用户隐私。
5. 灵活简码配置选项
考虑到用户多样化需求，工具贴心设置简码去除功能，用户可按需自主决定是否去除简码，灵活适配不同使用场景。
6. 多元输入法适配拓展
值得一提的是，工具新增对五笔 98 的支持，进一步丰富了输入法适配范围，为更多用户群体提供专业、适配的词库构建服务。
—— By 酷安@合欢萱草
